"EMERALD MINE 9X" can match another game on price and top prize and still pay out very differently. This game is a game that pays many small prizes and few large ones. Of its unclaimed prize money, about three-quarters is in wins under $500 and the rest is in bigger prizes. Neither kind is better, and each suits different players.

Every line of EMERALD MINE 9X's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
5055.headline: What type of game it is

5057.body:
The most common win left on "EASY MONEY" is $2. The second biggest prize left is $10,000, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

Everything here about "EASY MONEY" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through November 19.
5057.headline: The prize table, line by line

5059.body:
"THE CASH WHEEL" has 762,820 prizes of $6 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with 30 left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

If "THE CASH WHEEL" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
5059.headline: The prize table, line by line

5060.body:
"FIND THE 7S" paid out its last $50,000 prize six months ago. The ticket still advertises it because printed tickets never change. Prize tables do change, and the biggest prize listed today is $10,000.

The numbers for "FIND THE 7S" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
5060.headline: Big prize shown, none left

5063.body:
"CA$H IN HAND" offers a top prize of $2 million and fourteen prize levels in all. The prize money leans toward small, frequent prizes. Games shaped like this pay small prizes often and large prizes rarely. This design never changes, while every other number on this page does.

Everything here about "CA$H IN HAND" comes from official Florida lottery numbers, current through November 19.
